Video comparison study

Compare Video A and Video B, then answer three questions for each pair:

  1. Scene consistency: When the camera returns to a place, do the objects, layout, and details still match their earlier appearance?
  2. Temporal stability: Look for flicker, objects suddenly appearing or disappearing, and shapes changing unnaturally.
  3. Overall quality: Which video looks clearer, more natural, and has fewer visual errors?

You can pause, replay, change playback speed, or open either video fullscreen.

Choose A or B for each question. Choose About the same if neither is better, or Cannot judge if there is not enough evidence. Your choices can differ between questions.

Click Save & next to save your answers online and continue. You can pause and resume with the same nickname and browser.
